notes.title: LOGistICAL 3: Earth - Wisconsin Puzzle Update, New Industry Popup, Multi-Nav
notes.notes:
[h1]LOGistICAL 3: Earth Map Updates[/h1]
All the industries are already placed and accessible. There are a few players who are getting access to the last of them. The "Super Tech" ones are pretty hard to get.

For development, its now just a matter of tidying up all those little rail bits that don't connect to the main lines, and any other place that isn't accessible... and of course making the game run and play better.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29807716/4c279b2b9f2f9a21c12b6a5496113621aeb341fa.png[/img]

Some players are starting to complete some major sections, like "All Towns in Germany".
Well done and feel free to brag about these huge accomplishments on the Discord brag channel (see link at the bottom of the page).
We enjoy seeing your brags, big or small. If you feel good about it, let us know.

[h2]Wisconsin Access Puzzle[/h2]
The puzzle to unlock Wisconsin has had some issues.
When you have access to Wisconsin by rail, you should be able to get access to road once you have completed 3 of the required resources (standard Airport/Airfield function).

This connection should show something (don't want to give too much away) that will allow you to continue playing with a different transport in that area. You made it through. That is the next puzzle.
For some players this "something" wasn't showing and therefore the puzzle stopped there.

To make it work now, fill another resource and the puzzle should complete.

Post in the LOGistICAL forum or Discord if you are still having issues at this point. It is a long difficult puzzle, and you are getting so close to the end.

[h2]Industry View Update[/h2]
The "Industry" view and the "Industry Buying" view have been updated to include paging, rather than shrinking the icons.

As many icons that can fit on the page, do. The rest will be on next/previous pages with "Paging" icons at the top of the popup.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29807716/b86196ac48bfe7c62fd3f7b86f1125ba8f732ca1.png[/img]

[h2]Multi-Nav[/h2]
The multi-nav tool has undergone a major patch to sort out various issues.

These patches should make using them easier as a "background" tool, allowing you to work on your other vehicles as it completes its shedule.

- Clicking a town when in Multi-Nav no longer cancels any current multi-navs.
- Trucks stop once they become empty, instead of continuing to follow the full trucks.
- When dragging a non multi-nav vehicle, the cargo went blank when the background multi-nav vehicles completed a town/business. Fixed.
- Trucks arriving late to the source industry were not getting full load if the first town/business was completed. Fixed.

This should lead to some other multi-nav updates to make the process even better. More about that as it happens.

[h2]Languages[/h2]
Another big thanks to those that are helping with the languages.
There are more "human" updates in this version covering many of the languages.
I have used machine translation in order to get the bulk of the work done, so it now a much easier process to tidy up any misinterpretations.

English, German, Russian, Italian, Dutch, French, Croatian, Spanish, Portuguese, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified), Korean


[h2]General Updates - Build #859f[/h2]
- Arrows to "unfound" broken roads are shown if 90% of roads are fixed in that region.
- Save of the broken road arrows status (on/off) in the save file.
- Access to Wisconsin rail/road puzzle has been updated as some players were have access issues.
- Industry popup now has paging instead of shrunken icons
- Town/Road/Industry compete popup now goes straight to icon view
- Icon view now has click instead of mouse-over to enlarge it.
- Move contracts popup now sits where you drop it rather than jumping to the left.
- Fixed issue of stats not working for some players (due to pressing the towns link in it and it saving that setting into their save).
- Fix to stop train stations joining to towns and businesses
- Multi-nav update: Clicking a town when in Multi-Nav no longer cancels any current multi-navs.
- Multi-nav update: Trucks stop once they become empty, instead of continuing to follow the full trucks.
- Multi-nav update: When dragging a non multi-nav vehicle, the cargo went blank when the background multi-nav vehicles completed a town/business. Fixed.
- Multi-nav update: Trucks arriving late to the source industry were not getting full load if the first town/business was completed. Fixed.

[h2]Puzzled?[/h2]

If you are having difficulties solving areas, pop over to the Steam Forum or the LOGistICAL Discord where there is a wealth of hints and player knowledge. Feel free to ask your own questions.

https://discord.gg/xdQ2Gws

Enjoy,

Sacada.

notes.title: LOGistICAL: Earth - Update #844p
notes.notes:
As promised I will continue to grow LOGistICAL: Earth with FREE updates and new content.

[h2]New Content[/h2]
Only a small amount of new content this time allowing everyone time to discover the huge amount already available.

- Norfolk Island, Australia
- Jeju Island, South Korea
- Chatham Islands, New Zealand
- Japan Rail
- South Korea Rail

To gain access to these new islands you will need to have made your way throughout lots of Europe and into Thailand. You will also need some Ocean Floaties.

[h2]Updates[/h2]
Lots up updates for this build. Many small interface changes and also a few subtle changes to the LOGistICAL engine.

[h3]Vehicle List[/h3]
Clicking the vehicle's icon will now select only the vehicle without recentering the map.
To recenter the map on the vehicle, double click the vehicles icon.

[h3]Roadworks[/h3]
There have been occurrences of roadworks not being selectable once newly discovered. This has been fixed.
Pins on roadworks will now disappear once all the roadworks for that node have been completed.

[h3]Maximum Road Speeds[/h3]
Players have been racing the trucks and have not been impressed with costly 2x trucks being beaten by some ordinary ones. This has been due to maximum road speeds.
These have now been slightly adjusted.
 
30% max road increase for purchased 2x trucks (this is not the 2x, 4x, 6x boosts)
50% max rail increase for trains
150% max airways increase for planes.

[h3]Contracts[/h3]
A few new contracts have been created to help you through various complex areas.
Other contracts give help to the LOGistICAL game play.

[h3]Dragging Vehicles[/h3]
New faster code to render the map when you drag vehicles.
Added some better detection code for where you drag, for both empty and full vehicles.

[h3]Planes[/h3]
It takes a while to get planes in LOGistICAL: Earth. A few snuck out early but they need pilots. Well done to those that have already made it there.
Once you get them you can fly to the Airports in every country.
To fly to airfields you need to first create an industry at the airfield. Use your trucks and trains for that.
Jumbo planes can't fly to airfields. They are just too big.
As you complete each resource line at an Airport/Airfield you can create a Single Storage at the Airport/Airfield of that resource type.
Complete three resource lines and the Airport/Airfield will create a road for trucks, if they don't already exist.
Complete all resource lines (ie the entire Airport/Airfield) to get more choices of Single Stores.

The onboard GPS computers in the planes still need an update to cross the International Date Line correctly. That should happen soon.

[h2]Maps[/h2]
You can now change the maps in the settings.
Click the checkbox to turn the satellite images on/off.
The slider will move between the various vector map styles. At this stage there are only two.

[h2]Pins[/h2]
Pins now appear in the cluster's town list (to the left of the town name).
Towns in the cluster list that have a pin, now appear at the top of the list.
Roadworks with pins will have the pins removed once the roadworks is complete.

[h2]Clusters[/h2]
The list of towns that appear on a cluster's mouse over has been increased to 15.
The number of additional towns at the bottom of a cluster mouse over does not include unfound towns.
There are some clusters which have "+" signs still showing. The plus sign indicates there is something not found within the area.
I have found there are still a few "+" signs showing where they shouldn't. I will be fixing those soon.

---

That's the list for this week. Lots more coming soon.
Enjoy,
Sacada.

notes.title: LOGistICAL 3: Earth release date
notes.notes:
LOGistICAL 3: Earth (L3E) is coming very soon...
Its big and there is a lot of content. It should keep you LOGistICALly happy for the next few years.

I have decided to push the release just one more month to make it better.
The new release date is the [b]23rd July 2020[/b].
For those that can't wait I have decided to create a [b]free demo[/b] so you can still start the game on the 25th June 2020. Demo play will contribute to the full game, so you won't have to restart later.
The testers are about 5-10% through the content as I slowly push areas and new functionality for them to play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29807716/c77386c45d8e9d3a72ba1b4ecbe4fb25840f6a3a.png[/img]
Here is a screen shot and some information about L3E:
[list]
[*] Satellite and other highly detailed map backgrounds
[*] Large truck list
[*] Truck flags indicating the depot they came from
[*] Ability to park trucks so you can buy more
[*] Images for many of the towns and businesses
[*] Hyperlinks with more information about the towns and businesses
[*] Clusters showing the number of towns and businesses within that area
[*] Filters to turn off parts of screen
[*] Search to find any of the 50k towns or 180k business including many with local language search
[*] Trucks, trains and ships
[*] Ports
[*] Train Stations
[*] Large amount of contracts
[*] Lots of new resources and industries
[*] Goals: Complete towns, complete businesses, complete clusters, complete contracts, complete regions, complete countries, complete EARTH
[*] 47,976 towns, 167,385 businesses, 250 regions, 14 vehicle depots, 1 planet.
[*] Interesting world attractions, museums, country capitals, state capitals plus other stuff.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29807716/47e8d3ecd8f757d91856db2d5fd701c940a7b842.png[/img]
There is so much new stuff that hopefully a FAQ will be ready prior to release. Here are some of the answers that you may be asking...
[list]
[*] [i]Is the entire LOGistICAL 3: Earth (L3E) a single module with a single price...[/i] YES.
[*] [i]Will the game be release in July 2020...[/i] I am trying hard to meet the release date.
[*] [i]Will the game run on my old PC...[/i] If you have 64 bit Windows with 8 Gigs of RAM then you should be ok.
[*] [i]Does L3E require internet...[/i] At this point, YES. L3E has on-line hi-res maps and high score charts.
[*] [i]Will new content be available after release...[/i] YES. At no additional cost
[*] [i]Is it the world's largest puzzle of the world?...[/i]
[/list]
